summary.text: Owen Farnsworth is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Tim Rudd; he lives in Murfreesboro and works at Lowe's.

paragraphs.text: Owen Farnsworth earned a high school diploma from Blackman High School.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Murfreesboro since he was 14, attended classes at Middle Tennessee State University, and currently works at Lowe's.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 6, 2026.
Farnsworth's survey listed supporting working families, affordability and road infrastructure as his key messages.

His stated proposals include universal pre-kindergarten, guaranteed paid parental leave, abortion protections, expanding TennCare, eliminating the grocery tax, raising the minimum wage to at least $25 an hour, and expanding public transportation.
